_comment: R58.2 (2026-09-03): Phase 1.3 hardware preset for NVIDIA A10/A10G 24GB VRAM. Same Ampere sm_86 arch as RTX 3070, but 3x VRAM. A10 is common in cloud (AWS G5, Lambda, RunPod).

_hardware.name: A10 / A10G 24GB
_hardware._sm_arch_note: A10 is sm_86 (Ampere GA102), SAME as RTX 3070. The bundled `gpu-86-abort-r35` image works for A10 without rebuild.

_model_recommendations._comment: Same 24GB tier as RTX 4090. Multi-tenant A10 instances (cloud) — watch for noisy neighbors.
_model_recommendations._recommendation: Same as RTX 4090. Set Weight=1 if other VMs on the host are competing for VRAM.

docker._tag_note: Same tag as RTX 30xx — no rebuild needed for A10.

balancer._comment: For multi-tenant A10 (cloud), consider lower LB_NCTX_RELOAD_MAX_N_CTX to avoid VRAM contention with neighbors.
